findings.cpu: Both upstream checkouts have identical ArmCpu.cpp. SPI1008..1015 share IGROUPR31/ICFGR63; existing spiIpiConfigure and GICD_CTLR updates perform unprotected RMW, startThread launches processor_start concurrently, and smp_running increments were non-atomic. findings.amfi: The previous override incorrectly returned before inspecting error_out whenever the real syscall returned zero. The helper now reads the binary-qualified 0x404 output and overrides only a nonzero syscall return or output error_code. Successful calls remain untouched; copy faults are handled, messages are sanitized to at most48 bytes, and only the first32 failures are logged.

Host startup now configures this directly, late ports are covered by polling, and host/ports/devices use0x40000119. Port minimum power3 is requested outside setPowerState; duplicate success logs are suppressed and repeated failure logs cap at4 per port. The per-write full DMA dump is removed while first-HSE/HCE/U3 and16TRB capture remain.
findings.wifi: The actual supplied log records WMI20493 at49712ms, then MHI fatal and BHI_ERRDBG2=cafecace, not0x0ab6. Line2742 is therefore not claimed as measured from this file. The requested Q6 SRAM addresses are read through the existing window_read32 operation without MHI wakeup; PC/format/line and64 little-endian message bytes are bounded and sanitized, shared by fatal and timeout diagnostics before crash flush. No WMI command is skipped.
